1. Policy Design
1.1.1. ReAssure 3.0 can be issued to individual customer(s) or to a family with up to 5 children (refer to as family
floater).
1.1.2. This policy covers persons in the age group 91 days and above. The minimum entry age for adult is 18 years
and for dependent child is 91 days. The maximum entry age limit for adults in this product is 99 years. The
maximum entry age allowed for dependent child is 30 years.
1.1.3. There is no maximum cover ceasing age on renewals.
1.1.4. Relationships allowed with the Proposer: self, spouse, mother, father, mother-in-law, father-in-law, son,
daughter, sibling, grand-son, grand-daughter, employer-employee
1.1.5. Relationship with proposer where proposer is Employer- Employee, Employee’s Spouse, Employee’s Son,
Employee’s Daughter, Employee’s Father, Employee’s Mother, Employee’s Father-in-Law, Employee’s Moth-
er-in-Law,
1.1.6. In an Individual policy and a family floater, maximum up to 6 members can be included in a single policy.
1.1.7. Your premium depends upon your age, variant opted, base sum insured opted, no. of years of pre-existing
waiting period left in the policy and the Zone you live in.
1.1.8. Family Discount: 10% discount on premium if 2 or more members are covered under an individual policy.
1.1.9. Term discount: The default policy term for all plans is one year.
